title: Trio Fishing Charters
specs: Known for record class game fish and large numbers of fish caught
Port of Algoma home to two Wisconsin state fishing records
Wisconsin fishing license and Great Lakes trout stamp required
Must be 21 or older to bring alcoholic beverages aboard
Boat holds up to 6 customers plus crew; recommend 4 persons per group
Larger groups can be accommodated with additional boats
includes: All rods, reels, baits, and any other equipment needed
Soft drinks and Continental breakfast and snacks aboard
Fishing license included in some packages
Proper care of your catch (cleaning and bagging)
gap: Exact prices for some package rates not stated
blurb: Trio Fishing Charters offers guided fishing trips targeting salmon, trout, walleye, smallmouth bass, and musky on Lake Michigan. They operate 7 days a week with multiple trips daily. Trips include use of a large fishing vessel with experienced captain and mate, and all necessary fishing equipment.
extraNote: Fish in rain; weather does not affect fishing · Tipping customary 15-20% but optional
